recognize_zh: 箭頭所指兩個大型漿細胞核偏心、圓形、染色質呈車輪狀，細胞質豐富，中央偏灰藍而外緣呈鮮明的粉紅至洋紅色（左側細胞尤其明顯），右側細胞邊緣有粉紅色小泡狀突起；這種外緣紅染的「火焰細胞」（flame cell）來自免疫球蛋白堆積，旁邊兩個分葉嗜中性球可作大小對照。
features: Two large plasma cells (arrows), considerably larger than adjacent segmented neutrophils
Eccentric round nuclei with clock-face (cartwheel) coarse chromatin, without prominent nucleoli
Abundant cytoplasm with a blue-grey granular central zone and a peripheral pink-magenta rim (flame appearance)
Right cell with irregular cytoplasmic margin showing small pink blebs of cytoplasmic material
Two segmented neutrophils for size comparison; background RBCs and scattered platelets
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows two large plasma cells flanked by segmented neutrophils. The plasma cells have eccentric round nuclei with coarse clock-face chromatin and abundant cytoplasm that is blue-grey centrally and transitions to an intensely pink-magenta peripheral rim, with small pink cytoplasmic blebs at the margin of one cell. These represent flame cells, reflecting accumulation of immunoglobulin, often IgA. Flame cells are not specific for neoplasia; the finding is consistent with flame cells in the reported plasma cell myeloma, with the diagnosis resting on plasma cell burden, clonality and clinical criteria.

ddx.dx: Reactive plasmacytosis (infection, chronic inflammation, autoimmune disease)
ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells can also show flame morphology but are polyclonal by kappa/lambda staining or flow cytometry and usually form less than 10% of marrow cells.
Mott cells contain multiple discrete round pale immunoglobulin globules rather than a diffuse pink peripheral cytoplasmic rim.
Early granulocytes have a paranuclear Golgi zone and discrete azurophilic or specific granules rather than clock-face chromatin and a pink-rimmed agranular cytoplasm.
LPL contains a spectrum of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells with an IgM paraprotein and MYD88 L265P mutation.
